title: The teardrop eye icon
thisBuild: App icon: the teardrop eye from your painting in the app's own icon style, for now. The painted version is saved for later.

Still new from the last build: Re-pitch on the Sample sheet's Play tab. One clear note moves to C so keys and chords play the notes they say; a melody or loop moves into the mess's key and keeps its length.
Settings, Playing: Auto-pitch new sounds re-pitches every new sound on a pad, and key-matched loops follow the mess's key.
watch: Look at the icon on your home screen and in the app drawer: does it read at that size?
Sample something melodic, tap Re-pitch, and play it on the keys: do the notes match the key names?
limits: Some launchers keep the old icon until the phone restarts or the launcher's cache clears.
Drums and noise have no note, so Re-pitch leaves them as they are.
